data.narrative: The student triaged an active admin API auth bypass as SEV1, delivered transparent stakeholder communications under intense executive pressure without minimizing data loss, implemented a robust defense-in-depth auth patch, and verified resolution across a 5-case test suite.

dimension_scores.observation: Classified unauthorized DELETE requests with empty auth headers as active SEV1 exploitation.
dimension_scores.evidence: Identified that 47 HTTP 200 responses from unknown IPs represented active data deletion requiring immediate containment.

dimension_scores.observation: Extracted WAF alert signatures and traced auth middleware execution paths.
dimension_scores.evidence: Observed Authorization header empty string parsing flaw in middleware.

dimension_scores.observation: Verified auth middleware against a 5-point test matrix.
dimension_scores.evidence: Tested empty string, whitespace, missing token, missing header (all 401), and valid Bearer token (200).

dimension_scores.observation: Delivered calm, accurate, and honest status updates to the VP of Product during an active SEV1 breach.
dimension_scores.evidence: Refused to falsely reassure stakeholders while confirming public redirect isolation for the demo.

dimension_scores.observation: Patched middleware with multi-check defense-in-depth logic.
dimension_scores.evidence: Added non-whitespace checks, Bearer format validation, and explicit token presence checks.

dimension_scores.observation: Authored comprehensive incident summary and stakeholder communication log.
dimension_scores.evidence: Documented full incident lifecycle in progress/module-05-diagnosis.md.

strengths: Demonstrated exceptional leadership and transparent communication under executive pressure during a live SEV1 breach.
Implemented a robust, defense-in-depth authentication middleware patch with complete 5-case verification.
data.recommendation: Maintain rigorous communication cadences when tackling complex multi-layer bugs in Module 06.
